requirements.text: Create a record of the history of Scouting and your place in that history.
With the help of your den leader, parent, or guardian and with your choice of media, go on a virtual journey to the past and create a timeline.

provenance.notes: Requirement text verbatim from the USSSP archive of the pre-2024 program.
